top_signals.title: Foreign Funds Bought Most China Bonds Since May on Haven Appeal
top_signals.summary: Global investors boosted their holdings of onshore Chinese government bonds at the fastest pace since May last month, underscoring growing foreign interest in yuan debt that has remained relatively insulated from global market turmoil.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: New Zealand Inflation Expectations Remain Anchored Above 2%
top_signals.summary: New Zealand’s long-term inflation expectations eased in the fourth quarter, adding to signs that a fresh wave of higher fuel prices is not becoming embedded in the economy.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Peraire-Bueno brothers acquitted of wire fraud in $25 million Ethereum MEV case
top_signals.summary: A judge acquitted the Peraire-Bueno brothers of wire fraud over the Ethereum MEV exploit, ruling prosecutors showed no misrepresentation.

top_signals.title: Marine Corps doubles, extends contract for M27 rifles
top_signals.summary: The service began replacing its infantry’s squad weapons with the M27 IAR in 2028 and will continue through 2028.
